CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION taste_private.advance_round(p_action text, p_round_id uuid, p_work_id bigint, p_score integer, p_language text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select taste_private.advance_round_v2(p_action,p_round_id,p_work_id,p_score,p_language,20);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION taste_private.advance_round_v2(p_action text, p_round_id uuid, p_work_id bigint, p_score integer, p_language text, p_goal integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select taste_private.advance_round_v3(p_action,p_round_id,p_work_id,p_score,p_language,p_goal);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION taste_private.cover_lookahead(p_round_id uuid, p_work_id bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare r public.taste_rating_rounds; next_work bigint;
begin
  select own.* into r from public.taste_rating_rounds own
  where auth.uid() is not null and own.user_id = auth.uid() and own.id = p_round_id and own.completed_at is null
    and not exists (select 1 from public.taste_rating_rounds newer where newer.user_id = own.user_id and newer.round_number > own.round_number)
    and exists (select 1 from public.taste_rating_offers o where o.round_id = own.id and o.user_id = own.user_id and o.work_id = p_work_id and o.decision = 'offered');
  if r.id is null then return null; end if;
  -- The isolated shared test target already delegates v2 to its v3 inventory
  -- implementation. Reuse that existing eligibility policy, never change it.
  if position('taste_private.advance_round_v3(' in pg_get_functiondef(to_regprocedure('taste_private.advance_round_v2(text,uuid,bigint,integer,text,integer)'))) > 0 then
    select w.id into next_work from public.works w
    join taste_private.eligible_inventory_v1 i on i.work_id=w.id and i.language=r.language
    where taste_private.inventory_current_v1(w.id,r.language)
      and not exists(select 1 from public.ratings x where x.user_id=r.user_id and x.work_id=w.id)
      and not exists(select 1 from public.user_book_status x where x.user_id=r.user_id and x.work_id=w.id and x.status='read')
      and not exists(select 1 from public.taste_rating_offers x where x.user_id=r.user_id and x.work_id=w.id
        and (x.round_id=r.id or x.decision<>'skipped' or not coalesce((to_jsonb(r)->>'revisit_prior_skips')::boolean,false)))
    order by
      (select count(*) from public.taste_rating_offers x join public.works prev on prev.id=x.work_id where x.round_id=r.id and prev.author_id=w.author_id),
      (select count(*) from public.taste_rating_offers x join public.work_catalog_categories prev on prev.work_id=x.work_id
        where x.round_id=r.id and exists(select 1 from public.work_catalog_categories c where c.work_id=w.id and c.category_id=prev.category_id)),
      (select count(*) from public.ratings popularity where popularity.work_id=w.id) desc,
      (w.cover_id is not null) desc,w.id limit 1;
  else
    select w.id into next_work from public.works w
    where not exists (select 1 from public.ratings x where x.user_id = r.user_id and x.work_id = w.id)
      and not exists (select 1 from public.taste_rating_offers x where x.user_id = r.user_id and x.work_id = w.id)
      and exists (select 1 from public.editions e where e.work_id = w.id and
        ((r.language = 'nl' and lower(e.language) in ('nl','nld','dut')) or (r.language = 'en' and lower(e.language) in ('en','eng'))))
    order by
      (select count(*) from public.taste_rating_offers x join public.works prev on prev.id=x.work_id where x.round_id=r.id and prev.author_id=w.author_id),
      (select count(*) from public.taste_rating_offers x join public.work_catalog_categories prev on prev.work_id=x.work_id
        where x.round_id=r.id and exists(select 1 from public.work_catalog_categories c where c.work_id=w.id and c.category_id=prev.category_id)),
      (select count(*) from public.ratings popularity where popularity.work_id=w.id) desc,
      (w.cover_id is not null) desc, w.id
    limit 1;
  end if;
  if next_work is null then return null; end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('roundId',r.id,'fromWorkId',p_work_id::text,'locale',r.language,'workId',next_work::text);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION taste_private.inventory_current_v1(p_work_id bigint, p_language text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists(select 1 from taste_private.eligible_inventory_v1 i
    join public.editions e on e.id=i.edition_id and e.work_id=i.work_id
    where i.work_id=p_work_id and i.language=p_language and i.policy_version='taste_eligibility_v1'
      and length(trim(coalesce(e.title,'')))>0
      and lower(regexp_replace(trim(e.language),'^.*/',''))=any(case p_language
        when 'nl' then array['nl','nld','dut','dutch'] when 'en' then array['en','eng','english'] else array[]::text[] end)
      and i.source_snapshot=taste_private.inventory_snapshot_v1(i.work_id));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION taste_private.inventory_snapshot_v1(p_work_id bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object('work',to_jsonb(w),'author',to_jsonb(a),
    'editions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) order by e.id) from public.editions e where e.work_id=w.id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'categories',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) order by c.category_id) from public.work_catalog_categories c where c.work_id=w.id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'memberships',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('membership',to_jsonb(m),'collection',to_jsonb(c)) order by m.collection_id)
      from public.collection_books m join public.collections c on c.id=m.collection_id where m.work_id=w.id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'traits',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by t.trait,t.source,t.source_key)
      from public.work_trait_evidence t where t.work_id=w.id),'[]'::jsonb))
  from public.works w left join public.authors a on a.id=w.author_id where w.id=p_work_id;
$function$
